prompt:
Create a production-quality desktop WEBPAGE DESIGN COMP in the chosen "Alphabet Storm" visual world, adapted to a Traditional Chinese student LINE Bot development record. Read-mode document, edge-to-edge webpage 1440x1000 landscape, no browser/device/desk chrome, no poster. Reference images define only the BLACK/WHITE/SILVER palette, monumental grotesk lettering, glyphs dissolving/reforming, sparse rules and open field. REPLACE ALL reference branding and words: no "AS", no "Alphabet Storm", no "WORDS SHAPE WEATHER", no "CLOUD", no birds, no river, no weather instrument, no foreign logos. The real subject is the LINE Bot command words "記錄" and "查詢": a bold typographic field where these exact Chinese words condense out of and trail into individual smaller Chinese glyphs. Pure font glyphs and countable characters, no textures, organic shapes, sculpture, grain, photographic material, illustration or painted surfaces. This typographic motion concept occupies the page frame/heading only; calm readable 16-18px Traditional Chinese body columns remain untouched by glyphs. Black #0A0A0A, white #FFFFFF, silver #C0C5CC and pale gray #E6E8EB. Typeface Chinese geometric sans/grotesk like Noto Sans TC, display weight 900, body 400. Clear normal native navigation anchors. No generic hero metric cards, rounded card dashboards, fake chat screenshots, contact form, search function or invented extra features. Actual project name "待辦小幫手"; actual document title "LINE Bot 改善紀錄"; actual opening "新增查詢功能，讓記錄的待辦可以回看。" Required section headings "原本的問題", "修改內容", "前後差異", "重新測試結果", links "使用說明", "第一版封存". Actual factual status "14 組本機測試通過" and "LINE 真人測試待完成" clearly readable; no fake completed LINE claims. Only date "2026-10-05"; current version "0.2.0"; before version exactly "0.1.0". Hard content: same input "查詢" before returns "使用方式：記錄：待辦事項", after returns "你的待辦事項（共 1 筆，顯示最新 1 筆）：" and "1. 星期五交報告". Three local test rows show "記錄：星期五交報告" -> "已記錄：星期五交報告。", "記錄：" -> "請輸入要記錄的待辦事項。", "你好" -> usage help. Do not improvise actual Bot replies. Main reader goal: quickly understand what changed, compare true results, find evidence and archived v1. Reading, not a surreal art poster, must be apparent from the image alone. Strong committed typography in the frame, quiet clear document in the body. Show several sections and evidence beyond opening.
COMPOSITION B: slim full-width top navigation with real project title. Under it, a large left 35% typographic field shows the command "查詢" in two giant bold Chinese glyphs; its right edge dissolves into individual falling black glyphs, constrained to that field. Right 65% holds a calm white reading document: real title and opening, problem and modifications stacked, thin-lined same-input before/after comparison. The statuses are a sober horizontal text row between heading and first prose section. Below first fold, the test evidence table takes the document width, with source notes on its outside margin. No decorative panels, no contact/search UI. Dense but clean black typography with silver selected-word echoes. Keep text comfortably legible.
